# S4.16c — C1/C2 verification depth (§5f)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.16b` (PR #81) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the §5f C1/C2 verification depth: judged validators
and hosted `end_state` verdicts (`R-2.7.1²`), the
belief-state reconciler class with judged divergence
detectors (`R-2.7.2b`), and independent
critics/evaluators with the `execution_alignment` class
and `probe` mode (`R-2.7.3`) — all under the
`offline-only` budget: the kernel never calls a model;
judged inputs arrive as caller-supplied verdicts validated
against their declarations.

**Validators** (`R-2.7.1²`): `ValidatorDeclaration`
enforces the judged contract — `judge ⇒ ¬deterministic`,
`judge ⇒` `profile_ref` + assumption debt, judged surface
⇒ `required_inputs` declares `ModelIo`, `side_effects`
read-only — and verdict authority is detector-bound at
admission (deterministic ⇒ `kernel`, judged ⇒ `delegate`,
human ⇒ `principal`). `Verdict` gains additive judged
members `bundle_id`, `calibration_ref`,
`independence_summary`, `uncited_findings` (CC8 — old
bodies decode). `check_judged`/`admit_hosted` validate
caller-supplied judge verdicts;
`check_end_state`/`evaluate_gate_hosted` run the floor-9
gate over `end_state` assertions with three honest
outcomes — met, unmet, unread (an unobserved assertion is
a failure, never a guessed pass).

**Reconciler** (`R-2.7.2b`): `ReconcilerDeclaration` +
`declare_reconciler` register the `execution_alignment`
variant; `ReconcileContext`/`fold_reconcile_context`
project the belief-state facts (receipts, watermarks,
forgotten/truncated/unread-offload refs, refused effects,
progress items, repetition windows) over
`environment`/`kernel`-authority rows only (CC2 — the
projection confers `kernel` on driver-emitted
kernel-producer rows; every other unprovenanced row stays
`unverified`). `reconcile_c2` runs the six C2 detectors —
D1 `phantom_observation`, D4 `stale_belief`, D7
`censored_evidence`, D8 `progress_regression`, D9
`evidence_inversion`, D10 `no_progress_loop` — emitting
deterministic records (`charged_to = instrument`,
`mode = ledger_only`, sorted/deduped evidence refs)
beside the byte-identical C0 base record. Judged records
annotate via `reconcile_judged` but `hold_admissible()`
is the only gate read — judged findings never
independently hold or veto completion. `probe` mode
dispatches declared probes through `ProbePort` as ordinary
charged effects; a denied probe downgrades any `agree` to
`unverifiable`. Γ lands as `HarnessRule` definition data
(`gamma_from_rules`); `cap_outside_gate` bounds
outside-gate interventions; `na_classes` renders every
judged class `n/a{class}` unless `ModelIo` is in the
participant's observability — `end_state`-only hosts get
honest n/a rows. `feed_back_notices` emits one
`kernel_notice` per `(class, subject)` per turn (F6).

**Critics/evaluators** (`R-2.7.3`): `critic_rt` lands the
runtime legs — `admit_probe` over a closed read-only
capability set with prohibited-domain refusals;
`check_bundle_frozen` bundle immutability;
`judge_comparative` consuming both orderings;
`panel_reduce` majority-with-withholding;
`calibration_status_at` with hard expiry;
`admit_quarantined`/`verdict_taint`/`pi_admission`
raise-only quarantine; `declare_critic_gate` +
`critic_gated_payload` (the `control.critic.gated` audit
row — a new registered ledger class);
`check_critic_isolation` at spawn; `veto_only` /
`charged_to_evaluator` classification.

**Driver** gains `DriverConfig.reconciler`: `Some` binds
the C2 fold over the projected context and emits
`context.artefact.delivered{kind = kernel_notice}`
feedback; `None` reproduces the byte-identical C0 path
(`disabled_reconciler_is_byte_identical_c0`).

**Extraction channels**: `claims::extract_parsed` /
`extract_judged` produce `ExtractedBy::{Parsed,Judged}`
claims capped at `PARSED_CONFIDENCE_CAP_PPM` —
`extract_judged` is a deterministic fold over
caller-supplied judge output.

**Evaluation**: `hh-eval::interventions` —
`interventions_experiment` pairs reconciler-on/off cells
under `MatchSpec` (`match_gaps` refuses before pairing,
CC9) and reports the `false_completion_rate`,
`gate_hold_count`, `reconciliation_cost`, `task_success`
deltas; `hh-ontology`/`hh-lab` carry judged-cell
`calibration_ref`/`exploratory` members and serialization.

Requirement ids: `R-2.7.1²`, `R-2.7.2b`, `R-2.7.3` —
closes `AC-R-2.7.2b-{1–5,7}`, `AC-R-2.7.3-{4–6,8,11–12}`;
`removability(0…3)` green.

## Changes

- **`crates/hh-verification`** — `reconciler.rs` (new):
  `ReconcilerDeclaration`/`declare_reconciler`,
  `ReconcileContext` + `Watermark`/`ProgressFact`/
  `RepetitionFact`, `reconcile_c2` (D1/D4/D7–D10),
  `reconcile_judged`, `ProbePort`/`reconcile_probe`,
  `feed_back_notices`, `cap_outside_gate`,
  `gamma_from_rules`, `disable_gamma_recipe`,
  `EndStateAssertion`/`HostedGateFacts`/
  `evaluate_gate_hosted`, `na_classes` (ModelIo-gated;
  ×17 unit tests). `critic_rt.rs` (new): the critic
  runtime legs above (×8 unit tests). `validators.rs`:
  `check_judged`, `admit_hosted`, `check_end_state`,
  judged-declaration contract + authority-by-detector,
  additive `Verdict` judged members. `claims.rs`:
  `extract_parsed`/`extract_judged`,
  `hold_admissible()`, additive `calibration_ref`/
  `independence_summary` record members. `critics.rs`:
  `PanelRecord`, probe-capability declaration members.
  `events.rs`: `critic_gated`, `kernel_notice`, judged
  member serialization. `bind.rs`:
  `fold_reconcile_context` (the C2 fact projection).
  `lib.rs`: module registrations.
- **`crates/hh-control`** — `driver.rs`: `reconciler`
  config field, `fold_reconcile_context` invocation,
  `reconcile_c2` dispatch with C0 fallback,
  `hold_admissible` gating, `kernel_notice` feedback
  emission. `tests/s3_10.rs`:
  `bound_reconciler_emits_d7_and_kernel_notice` +
  additive-member fixture updates.
- **`crates/hh-ledger`** — `classes.rs`:
  `control.critic.gated` kind-table entry + class
  declaration (`led`, events-observable, audited).
- **`crates/hh-eval`** — `interventions.rs` (new):
  `interventions_experiment`, `match_gaps`,
  `InterventionsExperimentInput`/`Tier`/`Outcome`.
  `catalogue.rs`: `false_completion_rate`/
  `gate_hold_count`/`reconciliation_cost` rows. `judge.rs`,
  `lib.rs`: judged-cell plumbing. `tests/s4_16c.rs` (new,
  ×3).
- **`crates/hh-ontology`** — `eval.rs`: judged-cell
  `calibration_ref`/`exploratory` members + `opt_bool_at`.
- **`crates/hh-lab`** — `analysis.rs`/`exemplars.rs`:
  judged metric-cell serialization.
- **`crates/hh-analysis`/`hh-bench`/`hh-embed`/`hh-fleet`/
  `hh-monitor`/`hh-results`** — additive `Verdict`-member
  fixture updates (CC8).
